feeds.title: Portland Mercury » Music
feeds.description: Portland Mercury is an alternative bi-weekly newspaper and media company founded in 2000 in Portland, Oregon. It has a sibling publication in Seattle, Washington, called The Stranger. They share articles about Music, Portland Mercury, News, Entertainment and more. Check their music section to know about the latest news in the industry.

feeds.title: SenateAires Men's Chorus Blog
feeds.description: Read the latest posts in the SenateAires Men's Chorus Blog. The Oregon SenateAires Barbershop Chorus exists for the propagation and preservation of the unique Americana style of a cappella harmony, and to encourage interested individuals to learn and master the craft, while altruistically supporting the community through the artform.

feeds.title: JWF Blog
feeds.description: The Jeremy Wilson Foundation Blog is dedicated to providing emergency financial assistance and improving the overall well-being of individual musicians, industry workers, and their families during times of medical crises. For more than a decade, they have been dedicated to improving the overall well-being of local musicians and their families during times of medical crisis.

feeds.title: Portland Monthly » Music
feeds.description: Portland Monthly chronicles one of America's most innovative cities, inspiring readers to explore. A guide to Portland's vibrant music scene, featuring coverage of homegrown bands and touring acts across rock, pop, hip-hop, classical, jazz, folk, and more.

feeds.title: Freeform Portland Blog
feeds.description: Freeform Portland seeks to provide an authentic and inclusive space for DJs of all musical expressions and identities. They aim to educate and empower their all-volunteer community through DJ training, unconventional music programming, and opportunities for skill development.

feeds.title: East Portland Blog » Music
feeds.description: East Portland Blog is the world's foremost group blog and the last independent forum of ideas in the Pacific Time Zone. EPB was founded in 2008 to provide quality internet content relating to humor, history, video, religion, politics, music, and more. Featuring deathless music from talented contributors located both in East Portland and around the world.

feeds.title: Northwest School of Music Blog
feeds.description: Find all the information you need about the Northwest School of Music here on their blog. Northwest School of Music is the region's premier institution for the study of the arts. They offer lessons to students of all ages and abilities throughout Salem and surrounding areas.

feeds.title: The Source Weekly » Music
feeds.description: Interviews with local bands, concert reviews and the live music scene. The Source Weekly Newspaper is the Bend / Central Oregon's newspaper for arts, entertainment, recreation, local news, live music, culture and events in Bend and Central Oregon.

feeds.title: Oregon Music Teachers Association
feeds.description: Keep up with the latest news about Oregon's music teachers and their students. Oregon Music Teachers Association (OMTA) is a professional organization of music educators comprising teachers in private studios, commercial music schools, public and private schools, and college music faculty across Oregon.

feeds.title: Arbielle
feeds.description: Arbielle writes about viridescent folk music for the soul. 'Arbielle' is Rachel Jumago, an Oregon-based singer-songwriter with an open heart, a beautiful voice, and plenty of stories to share. Her viridescent folk songs feature melodic piano and authentic lyrics, ranging from playful to poignant to protest.

feeds.title: My Voice Music
feeds.description: My Voice Music (MVM) teaches youth to write, record, and perform original songs. Their vision is that all youth have the opportunity to find and share their artistic voice. Visit the blog to know more about their news, sessions, the youth, and latest events.

feeds.title: Oregon Music News
feeds.description: Oregon's only all-genre, online music magazine covers music news and events in Portland and throughout the state. The only all-genre, online music magazine that covers music news and events in Portland and throughout the state.

feeds.title: Eleven PDX
feeds.description: Eleven Magazine is the culmination of the blood, sweat, tears, curse words, sleep deprivation, daydreams, and passion of an incredibly dedicated group of people. Eleven Magazine is your source for everything music, community, and culture related in the Portland metropolitan area.

feeds.title: GO! Eastern Oregon » Sound Check
feeds.description: Go Eastern Oregon | Travel, Adventures & Local Attractions in Eastern Oregon

feeds.title: Portland Radio Project » Music
feeds.description: Portland Radio Project is your non-profit community radio station, closely tuned in to PDX. Our mission is to elevate local artists and organizations through streaming, broadcasting, and podcasting, engaging new generations of art lovers and community supporters. They are leaders in the movement toward a more equitable media landscape.

feeds.title: XRAY.fm Blog
feeds.description: Their programming is a progressive blend of talk and music that amplifies both the sounds and the voices of our city. XRAY.fm's music is delivered by 80+ of Portland's own DJs, respected promoters and record label owners, lauded local musicians, and the biggest music geeks. Shows run the gamut from indie to hip hop to metal to soul to psych and beyond, with a dual focus on curation and discovery.

feeds.title: All Classical Portland
feeds.description: All Classical Portland is an independent and community-funded radio station, providing access to classical music, outstanding performances, information about the arts, and more since 1983. All Classical Portland believes that this music and this service should be accessible and inviting to all people, and all communities.

feeds.description: 'ONE OF THE WORLD'S LEADING MUSIC FESTIVALS'

feeds.title: Oregon City Music Academy Blog
feeds.description: Oregon City Music Academy Blog Visit this page every week for a new blog post based on music lessons and instruments you are interested in learning to play.

feeds.description: Preserving Oregon's Musical Heritage

feeds.title: Deepest Currents
feeds.description: Deepest Currents is a Portland, Oregon-based music website, focusing on new releases and general reviews, as well as cultural events happening around the Pacific Northwest. Genre coverage varies widely, highlighting everything from indie rock to experimental.

feeds.title: The RUSH Collective Blog
feeds.description: The RUSH Collective Blog shares details about the band, their performances, and more about RUSH. The RUSH Collective was founded in 2018 by musicians who shared an immense admiration for the music of the Rock Hall Of Fame Canadian prog-rock trio.

feeds.title: PDX Presents - Live Music Venues & Portland Artists - PDX Presents
feeds.description: Dive into the portal for PDX Presents, where you'll find live concert photography, music playlists, artist and venue features, and information about the explosive Portland Music scene. PDX Presents covers live music, music business, and entertainment in Portland, OR

feeds.title: The Bulletin » Music
feeds.description: Explore The Bulletin and read the most recent posts about music and artists. The Bulletin is a newspaper in Bend, Oregon, United States. The Bulletin is owned by EO Media Group. The Bend Bulletin was first published as a weekly newspaper on March 27, 1903.
